versions.changelog:
Initial release of KES Skills, a comprehensive skill pack for KingbaseES V8/V9.

- Provides 31 skills covering deployment, SQL core, drivers, frameworks, operations, performance tuning, migration, troubleshooting, and extensions.
- Includes support for major programming languages (Java, Python, Go, Node.js, C/ODBC, PHP, Perl) and frameworks (Hibernate, SQLAlchemy, EF Core, etc.).
- Features operational tools for backup, high availability, security compliance, monitoring, and user management.
- Supports advanced performance optimization and database migration.
- Compatible with multiple Linux distributions, Windows versions, and a range of hardware architectures.
